text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond works hard at her training. 
However, her Trainer feels that she might 
be pushing herself too hard in her desire 
to be strong enough to overcome the jinx.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer asks Mejiro McQueen for a 
joint training session, and she gladly 
accepts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During roadwork, Satono Diamond buys a 
drink. She decided to challenge the 
superstition that anyone who drinks it 
will lose their next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro McQueen pointed out that 
obsessing over jinxes is what causes one 
to lose composure. She emphasized that one 
should focus solely on running their own 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words, Satono Diamond 
dedicated herself to polishing and 
perfecting her own running.
